confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables, not checked against live menus, listings or current prices. Argentina's peso regime and high inflation make USD price levels volatile, so anchors could be well off by mid-2026. Restaurant and beer anchors are steadier than lodging anchors, and July overlaps Argentine winter school holidays, which may lift some hotel and hostel rates. Cocktail and wine_glass are set in line with the beer anchor because direct knowledge of current bar and wine-by-the-glass prices is weak. No web search was used for the city anchors. The FX value comes from a web search summary of the RBA daily rate page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against the supplied Santiago, Chile and Lima, Peru figures, with Cartagena, Colombia as a reference for upper-range hotels. Buenos Aires values generally fall between Lima and Santiago, nearer Santiago for restaurants and three-star rooms.
